create_StudyPaths_instance: create a StudyPaths instance with a subject_uid to access MEG recording paths
test_is_valid: test the StudyPaths is_valid method to check if raw and metadata files exist
get_raw_path: get the raw MEG data file path for a subject using the StudyPaths raw property
get_metadata_path: get the metadata file path for a subject using the StudyPaths metadata property
get_wave_file_path: get the audio wave file path for a stimulus name using StudyPaths wave_file method
